sources.summary: MEPs agree to implement deal almost 12 months after it was proposed and just days before deadline of US threat to raise tariffs The European parliament has given its final approval to implement last July’s tariff agreement with Donald Trump. Facing a threat of increased tariffs if the deal was not sanctioned by 4 July, MEPs agreed to approve the deal, with two main provisos. Continue reading...
